title: Fix Engine Mcp App Build
description: Fix `npm run mcp:inspector` failing with `[commonjs--resolver] Missing "./internal" specifier in "vite" package`. The engine mcp-app build pulls in `compose/sketchpad/index.tsx`, whose node-only test block contains static-string dynamic imports (`./vite.config.ts`, `@compose/assets/...json` with import attributes). Rollup still analyzes those literals, dragging in `@vitejs/plugin-react` which does `await import("vite/internal")` (removed in vite 7.3.1). Split the specifier strings so rollup cannot pre-analyze them, matching the existing `"node" + ":fs/promises"` pattern.
summary: Fixed `npm run mcp:inspector` build failure. Root cause: the engine mcp-app build pulled in `compose/sketchpad/index.tsx`, whose node-only test block contained static-string dynamic imports. Even with `/* @vite-ignore */` rollup still statically analyzed the literal specifiers (`./vite.config.ts` and `@compose/assets/compose/metabolism.kit.compose.json`), dragging in `compose/sketchpad/vite.config.ts` → `@vitejs/plugin-react@5.1.2`, which calls `await import("vite/internal")` — a subpath that was removed in vite 7.3.1. Fix: store the specifiers in local variables built via `[...].join(".")` so rollup's commonjs-resolver can't pre-resolve them; mirrors the existing `"node" + ":fs/promises"` pattern for the other node-only imports. Verified with `npm --workspace @compose/engine run build:mcp-app` → `✓ built in 32.04s`, `dist/mcp-app.html` 44,511 kB.
